說明: 《畫海人》戰鬥裡的怪物圖（160 隻，一隻一張）。名稱是「怪_」加上 畫海人/js/data.js 的 ENEMIES 名稱。存成 img/enemy/名稱.webp（512×512，透明背景）。rank 是精英或首領，試畫與排順序用。

style.enemy: Anime film creature design for a fantasy game: exactly one creature or figure shown whole, centred, filling about two thirds of the frame, seen from a slight three-quarter angle. Clean crisp anime line art with cel shading and soft painterly texture, the same hand-painted anime film style as the game's scenes. Medieval European sea-folklore feel. Brighter and clearer than a background painting so it reads at small size: a clear silhouette, a muted grey-blue base palette with the accent colours described below, soft rim light. Nothing else in the frame: no ground, no scenery, no frame, no border. No text, letters or numbers anywhere; any writing is drawn as abstract squiggles. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
